title: Earliest systematic coal exploitation for fuel extended to ~3600 B.P.
lineage: Cited passage inspected; retained file is a brief paraphrased research note.

passages.note: Authors report evidence of coal collection, storage and combustion at Jirentaigoukou, Xinjiang, around 3600 BP. BP is referenced to 1950 CE; this does not rule out earlier sporadic coal use.
